<issue_description>
Heap-use-after-free in the Zend engine: div_function (Zend/zend_operators.c) may free/destroy the result zval too early during a compound division assignment when the destination is the same as the dividend. If the division operation fails (for example, division by zero), subsequent bytecode handlers (e.g. ZEND_ASSIGN_OP_SPEC_* handlers) can access or add a reference to the already-freed zval (seen in zend_gc_addref), resulting in a heap-use-after-free that can crash the interpreter and may be exploitable.
